ValidationRule.description: The Legacey: a unit whose LL Share Name is a landowner (filled and not BUILDER) needs AGPA Date and AGPA Number when it is created or edited. Automatic updates that only move the unit Status / Current Booking (quote blocks it, booking books it, cancellation or swap releases it) are let through so bookings keep working on units whose AGPA is not filled yet (2026-11-18).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Project__r.Name = "The Legacey", NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(LL_Share_Name__c))), TEXT(LL_Share_Name__c) <> "BUILDER", OR(ISBLANK(AGPA_Date__c), ISBLANK(AGPA_Number__c)), OR( ISNEW(), NOT(OR(ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISCHANGED(Current_Booking__c))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: AGPA Date and AGPA Number are required for a landowner unit (LL Share Name other than BUILDER) in The Legacey.
